phases.title: Package Header Parsing & VFS Architecture
phases.notes: (Exists) PackageFile header/entry/block parsing, PackageCatalog, tag-hash lookup. Solforge: PackageCatalog.Index.cs metadata index (package-index-v1/<root hash>.bin beside the data cache; headers for every patch file, tables for current packages, name rows; keyed by file name + length + write time, any change rebuilds; disabled cache = no index), PackageFile I/O split (ReadTables/LoadTables(bytes)), CollectNameRows/ApplyNameRows split, PackageCatalog.Search.cs (FindByClass, FindByType, GetPackageGroup, FindPackagesInGroup, GetPackageEntries). Check: tests/SunriseStudio.Packages.Tests (scratch packages always; --game-root times the warm open: 400+ files must open from the index under 1 s, skipped without -Game). Memory mapping not needed; the index is the profiled answer

phases.title: Block Decompression & Oodle Integration
phases.notes: (Exists) OodleDecoder (oo2core_3_win64.dll from the install, thread-safe pooled buffers), PackageKeys AES-128-GCM, raw blocks; no zlib path. Solforge: PackageCatalog.Parallel.cs (MaximumParallelDecodes bound, default min(cores, 8); ReadOriginalParallel warms a tag's blocks through the serial CopyBlock path on a bounded Parallel.For, capped at half the LRU, then assembles serially; ReadOriginalAsync; ReadOriginalAll bounded multi-tag reads in input order). Check: Packages.Tests compares serial vs parallel/all/async/bound-1 on PackageWriter scratch packages (a 1.6 MB 7-block tag); --game-root compares the 32 largest installed multi-block (Oodle + AES) tags on cold catalogs and prints both timings. Synthetic Oodle round trip not possible (no compressor binding); installed blocks cover the Oodle path

phases.title: Tag Deserialization & Structural Memory Mapping
phases.notes: (Exists) typed deserializers: Strings = Packages/LocalizedStrings.cs, Entity Templates = ComponentIndex.EntityConfigs + ComponentRoles.ReadConfig (EntityComponents.cs), Sound Banks = Audio/AudioCatalog.ReadBank + WwiseSoundBank.Nodes; Formats.TagReader. Solforge: Packages/TagHeaders.cs (Compose/TryDecompose per §5.4, ParseEntryTable/ParseEntryRecord/WriteEntryRecord per §5.2; PackageFile.LoadTables now parses through it), PackageCatalog.TryLocate, Packages/TagDependencyGraph.cs (TryAdd/Add reject cycle and self edges, RejectedEdges, Reaches, Closure, TopologicalOrder, bounded Build walk). Check: Packages.Tests (hash mapping, record round trip, 10,000-header parse best of 5 under 100 ms, DAG cycle rejection/order/Build); --game-root maps every installed hash and builds a native-dependency DAG from 200 entity templates. Memory mapping still not needed (Phase 05 index)

phases.title: Package Entry Table Modification & Block Writing
phases.notes: (Exists) PackageWriter.WritePatch/WriteNew/WriteReplacement (block placement, 8192-entry/16384-block/0x0100-0x0CFF limits), StringBankWriter. Solforge: Packages/PackageDelta.cs: PackageBlockAllocator (opens the source read-only, Replace/Append, places edits with PackageWriter.Place after the source's last block, writes an SFPD v1 project delta atomically: header bound to source length + metadata SHA-1, 32-byte redirect rows with PackageEntryOverride Replaced/Appended flags and old/new block info, 48-byte block records with target patch, raw flags, SHA-1), CheckLimits/CheckNewPackageId; PackageDelta (Read validates block SHA-1s, Matches, ReadEntry, BuildEntryTable = next patch entry table). PackageWriter.Place is now internal. Check: Packages.Tests mock replace + append into a scratch project delta, verifies redirects/blocks/bytes/table, source SHA-256/length/write time unchanged, limits, refusal to write over the source, damaged-block detection
